title: Relocatable unit: vehicle or building? Notice to fix proposed; District Court appeal attached (Waimakariri)
jurisdiction: New Zealand (MBIE, Building Act 2004): comparative test only; not an Alberta case; no Alberta applicability asserted
code_edition: Building Act s7, s8 and s40 (NZ)
document_type: MBIE determination under Building Act 2004 s188 (regulator decision on an individual matter); not an applicant's alternative-solution file

facts.text: Authority proposed a notice to fix because the unit, as presented, was a building and its construction had no building consent; the owner contended it is a vehicle outside the Act's definition.
The unit was relocated after the application; the determination considers it as presented when the authority applied, including evidence on immovability.
Conclusion: the unit as presented falls within s8(1)(b)(iii) of the Act; the authority correctly proposed the notice to fix (decision 1 March 2022).

Companion attachment: District Court reserved judgment [2022] NZDC 24083 (CIV-2022-009-000382, Judge C N Tuohy, judgment 9 December 2022) on a s208 appeal against Determination 2022/001 (appellant named in caption, p.1). Scanned, no text layer: p.1 header and p.22 paragraphs [69]–[73] read visually; [71] confirms the unit was a building under s8(1)(b)(iii) at filing; [72] reverses the findings that construction was building work under s7 and that the Council was correct to propose the notice to fix on that basis. Pages 2–21 not transcribed.
